title: "In this town everybody goes out… except me": your cosy night in
summary: Lip-sync the "in this town" sound while you do something calm, niche or nerdy instead of going out. AI writes the captions and picks your scene.
why: Virlo's trend page, updated November 24, 2026, lists "In this town everybody goes out partying except me" as a fresh TikTok format first seen November 11, with about 449 creators in the last 7 days. People lip-sync the line while doing a mundane or niche activity instead of partying. It's a new sound on the idea in our earlier "While they're out partying…" pack, with more focus on where you live.
steps: Find the trending "in this town" sound in your app.
Paste the main prompt into a chat tool and pick a caption and activity that feel like you.
Film yourself mid-activity, then look up and lip-sync the line straight to the camera.
Add the caption on screen and post it. Deadpan is funnier than a big smile.

prompts.label: Main prompt: your night-in scene
prompts.text: There's a TikTok trend where people lip-sync "in this town everybody goes out partying except me" while doing something calm, niche or nerdy instead. Help me make mine. Things I like doing at home: [list a few, like puzzles, baking bread, organizing my spice drawer, painting miniatures]. Give me 8 ideas. For each one, write a short scene to film (one sentence) and an on-screen caption under 12 words. Make them warm and a bit self-aware, not sad. No drinking jokes.

prompts.label: Variation: the small-town Canadian winter
prompts.text: Write 8 on-screen captions for the "in this town everybody goes out except me" lip-sync trend, set in a small Canadian town in winter. Ideas like shovelling the driveway at 9 p.m., watching the local hockey game on the community channel, waxing cross-country skis or making a huge pot of soup. Under 12 words each, funny and cosy, with Canadian spelling.

prompts.label: Variation: the student edition
prompts.text: Write 8 on-screen captions for the "in this town everybody goes out except me" lip-sync trend, from a student who is studying, colour-coding notes or doing a late-night library session instead. Under 12 words each, light and relatable, with a small proud twist at the end of each. Nothing about stress or burnout.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: still open, still working
prompts.text: I run [type of business] in [town]. Write 6 on-screen captions for the "in this town everybody goes out except me" lip-sync trend, showing me doing real behind-the-scenes work after hours: [list real tasks, like kneading tomorrow's dough, restocking shelves, finishing a custom order]. Under 12 words each. Warm and funny, no fake urgency, no made-up sales or claims.

tips: Start the clip mid-task, then look up right as the line starts.
The more oddly specific the activity, the better it lands.
Keep it upbeat. The joke is that you love your night in.
Only film people at home or at work if they've agreed to be in it.
